# Code Anchors: Canonical Record Digest

- `libs/record-digest/src/digest.ts` — the one digest implementation: the stated canonicalisation rule and the full lowercase-hex SHA-256 over the canonical form.
- `libs/record-digest/src/fetch.ts` — fetches the record issue body back from GitHub (the hashed artifact), its state, and the not-planned-is-not-approved reading; read-only.
- `libs/record-digest/src/run.ts` — the process runner seam the fetch goes through.
- `libs/record-digest/src/digest.spec.ts` — canonicalisation coverage: identical hashes across line-ending/trailing-whitespace variants, differing hashes on any other edit.
- `libs/record-digest/src/fetch.spec.ts` — fetch/approval-state coverage, including the not-planned closure.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-record-digest/SKILL.md` — the skill every stamping or verifying stage invokes instead of re-deriving the value.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.close.md` — stamps the reference and full hash into the close comment's machine block, the copy that survives the entry being consumed.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-record-digest/scripts/record_digest.ts` — the CLI wrapper printing the digest and approval state for a record issue.
